response.sql: WITH qc_projects AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'MISSING') as fundflux FROM scanqc sq JOIN projects p ON sq.arcref = p.arcregistry), grouped AS (SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM qc_projects GROUP BY fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_count, AVG(cnt) as avg_count FROM grouped) SELECT g.fundflux, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total_count as fraction_of_total, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.avg_count as count_divided_by_avg FROM grouped g CROSS JOIN totals t ORDER BY g.fundflux
